'''Gem Sirrom''' was a [[human]] [[senator]] of the [[Galactic Republic]]'s [[Galactic Senate|Senate]], where Sirrom was an ally of fellow Senator [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]].<ref name="SWVE" /> Shortly after the [[Mission to Mustafar|end]] of the [[Clone Wars]]<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> in [[19 BBY]],<ref name="Timelines">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref> Sirrom took part in Amidala's [[Padmé Amidala's funeral|funeral]] procession, walking behind the coffin with a group of other senators as it passed through<ref name="ROTS" /> the [[city]] [[Theed]] on the [[planet]] [[Naboo]]. Sirrom wore a [[Color|red]] [[Clothing|dress]] to the [[funeral]] and had light skin, brown [[hair]], and brown [[eye]]s.<ref name="SWVE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gem Sirrom appeared in the [[2005]] [[prequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']].<ref name="ROTS" /> The funeral scene that featured the character was filmed at [[Fox Studios, Sydney]] on [[September 16]], [[2003]].<ref name="MakingOf">''[[The Making of Star Wars Revenge of the Sith]]''</ref> Earlier in the film,<ref name="ROTS" /> an [[Galaxies Opera House|Opera House]] patron played by [[Jill Brooks]]<ref name="HSPotCE">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/postnotes/news20041124.html|series=Episode III Post Notes|text=Part of the Coruscant Elite}}</ref> can be seen wearing the same outfit as Sirrom.<ref name="ROTS" />

In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], Sirrom was identified in the [[2017]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="SWVE" /> The [[Gem Sirrom/Legends|name]] originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where it was first used in an entry for the character in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Databank (original)|Databank]], which had been published by [[2010]].<ref name="Databank">{{DB|character|gemsirrom|Sirrom, Gem}}</ref>
